answer.text: For a motorcycle not used for a month or longer, the manual advises disconnecting the battery terminals and removing the battery.
Before refitting the battery, check that its voltage is within specification; if it is not, recharge it at an authorised service workshop or battery dealer.
For re-use after storage, the manual says it is preferable to have the motorcycle prepared by a Royal Enfield Authorised Service Centre.

policy.text: Storage for a month or longer calls for disconnecting and removing the battery, and checking its voltage before refitting.
Preparation for re-use after storage is preferably done by a Royal Enfield Authorised Service Centre.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not give a step-by-step procedure for restarting a motorcycle that has been stored this long.
The manual does not say whether the motorcycle can be started without this preparation.
